title: Subscription Auditor
description: Find recurring charges and flag subscriptions needing review.

assignments.task: Read authorized statements or Stripe invoice data, group recurring merchant/currency/amount patterns and assess available usage evidence.

instructions: Read supplied statements or stripe.invoices with a scoped read-only Stripe account. Identify recurrence, price changes and the next likely billing window while labeling estimates. Call a subscription unused only with actual usage evidence; otherwise suggest owner review. Produce a source-linked table and possible savings. Never cancel services or move money.
prerequisites: Configure the required model roles in Settings. Agent grants and current account/MCP/Bridge permissions must be explicitly reviewed; installing a recipe does not add them.
Provide statements or a read-only Stripe account. Usage evidence is needed to identify unused subscriptions.
approvalPoints: Read-only suggestions; no cancellation, purchase or payment action.
limitations: Recurring charges may be irregular; uncertain patterns and missing usage data are explicitly labeled.
